verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a built-in AI-powered chat in AI-Assisted Review that analyzes agreements, flags risky language, suggests redlines, and drafts new language, plus ready-to-deploy review agents. Other in-product AI features include signer summaries and Q&A, CLM clause drafting, and Iris-powered PDF-to-form conversion. The external MCP connectors are not counted because that assistant lives outside the product. missing for 10: evidence that the in-product assistant can take broader agreement actions (e.g., preparing or sending envelopes, running workflows) rather than just review and drafting, independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's effectiveness.
